'''Promencious Four''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]], the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] old wreck of the [[Splendor (luxury cruiser)|''Splendor'']], a lost [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] luxury cruiser, was discovered in the lava fields of Promencious Four.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
Promencious Four was mentioned in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'', the sixth digital expansion of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" /> [[Promencius Four]] originated in the [[2015]] [[canon]] novel ''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'', written by [[Alexander Freed]].<ref name="BTC">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref>
